theme_rankings.tagline: 🚂 AI의 '밴더빌트' — 실제 업무에 AI 박는 운영자
theme_rankings.why_now: 추론 비용 90% 하락 + 엔터프라이즈 도입 본격. 진짜 텐베거 후보가 여기서 다수.
theme_rankings.risk: 밸류에이션 과열. 매출 성장 30%+ 못 보이면 멀티플 압축.

theme_rankings.why_now: MSFT·GOOG·META·AMZN 2026 Capex 합계 $400B+. AI 매출 회수 본격화 단계.
theme_rankings.risk: 광고·소비 둔화 시 Capex 가이던스 컷 가능. 빅테크 동반 변동성.

theme_rankings.why_now: HBM4·CoWoS·EUV 모두 캐파 부족 지속. 2027까지 수요 가시성 확보된 영역.
theme_rankings.risk: 사이클 정점 논쟁 + 중국 수출 규제 변동성. 어닝 미스 시 30% 낙폭 흔함.

theme_rankings.why_now: AI가 돌아가려면 전기 필요. 미국 변압기 대기 100주+ → 만드는 회사들 5년치 일감 확보.
theme_rankings.risk: 사이클 후반 진입 우려는 아직 작지만, 금리 급등 시 인프라주 동반 조정.

theme_rankings.why_now: 강한 추세장에서만 사용. 분할매수 + 손절선 명확히 + 자산의 5~10% 이하.
theme_rankings.risk: 장기 보유 ❌. 횡보·하락장에선 음의 복리(volatility decay)로 손실 누적.

theme_rankings.why_now: 인지노동 다음은 물리노동. 2027~2030 진정한 텐베거 가능 영역.
theme_rankings.risk: 상용화 시점 불확실. 미래 옵션밸류 비중 큼. 변동성 극심.

top_news.title: Fletcher Building Waiting on Meaningful Recovery in NZ Demand
top_news.summary: New Zealand’s largest construction materials company Fletcher Building Ltd. doesn’t expect a meaningful recovery in its markets until 2027, adding to signs of muted economic growth over the second half of this year.

top_news.title: Ex-Tricolor Executives Face SEC Lawsuit After Firm Collapse
top_news.summary: Tricolor Holdings founder Daniel Chu, who already faces federal criminal charges, and two other former executives were sued by the US Securities and Exchange Commission for allegedly defrauding investors before the used car seller and subprime lender imploded.

top_news.title: Uruguay Holds Interest Rates Steady With Inflation Below Target
top_news.summary: Uruguay’s central bank held interest rates steady for a fourth consecutive policy meeting with inflation below its target.

top_news.title: Walter Probe Weighs on Carvana as Traders Suspect Share Sale
top_news.summary: Shares of online used-car dealer Carvana Co. dropped Tuesday, hurt by concerns that one of the company’s largest investors — billionaire Mark Walter — may sell down his stake as he contends with a federal probe of his investment empire.

top_news.title: EM Rally Stalls Amid Surge in Treasury Yields, Mideast Tensions
top_news.summary: The recent rally in emerging-market assets stalled on Tuesday as a surge in long-term US Treasury yields and renewed tensions in the Middle East drained demand for risk, snapping a four-day winning streak in stocks and pushing borrowing costs higher.

top_news.title: Bond Traders Bite at Microsoft-Tied Data Center Junk-Like Yields
top_news.summary: Blackstone Inc.-backed QTS Realty Trust Inc. offered junk-like yields on a $3.9 billion high-grade bond to fund the construction of a Microsoft Corp.-linked data center in Georgia. It looks to have worked as the deal racked up demand of about six times that amount.

top_news.title: Gold Falls as Traders Weigh US Inflation, Rates Amid Bond Rout
top_news.summary: Gold declined as traders evaluated the outlook for US inflation and interest rates amid a global government bond rout.

top_news.title: Bond Traders Are Hedging Risk Fed Pivots to Rate Cuts in 2027
top_news.summary: Bond traders are changing gears again. After a raft of data helped all but price out interest rate hikes for the rest of the year, wagers in the options market are looking to hedge the risk that the Federal Reserve pivots to cutting rates in 2027.

top_news.title: Ripple’s Brokerage Arm Taps Private Placement Bond Market
top_news.summary: The prime-brokerage arm of digital-asset company Ripple has raised $275 million through the private placement bond market.

top_news.title: Stocks Fall As Global Bond Yields Stay Elevated | Closing Bell
top_news.summary: Comprehensive cross-platform coverage of the U.S. market close on Bloomberg Television, Bloomberg Radio, and YouTube with Scarlet, Fu, Isabelle Lee, Carol Massar and Joe Deaux. (Source: Bloomberg)
